text:
marta: Starting postmortem follow-up for the cache leak that caused OOM on 2009-12-00. Quick agenda: owner updates, profiling blockers, GC tuning, and fragmentation experiments.
aron: +1. Can we get a one-line summary of what the leak looks like now?
vijay: From heap dumps and perf counters: KV shard growth ~20%/hour under churn, persistent unreachable fragments after compaction, suspect partial reference held in router cache.
sasha: repro steps in CI are flaky but I have a deterministic trace with --alloc-trace attached at /tmp/alloc-trace-2009.log
marta: Action: sasha to produce minimal repro by EOD Monday. owner: sasha. timeline: 3 workdays. @sasha
sasha: ack, working on narrowing tensor lifecycle; will post a short patch to isolate allocator path.
aron: Action: I'll add a temporary hard limit per-shard (config: shard.max_memory_bytes) as a stopgap. owner: aron. ETA: tomorrow morning. Will also add a telemetry tag 'hard-limit-enforced'.
vijay: For longer term: profile kernel holding references. I can run jemalloc profiling and compare backtraces. Need a window for a production-like load — request permission to spin a small canary cluster.
marta: Approved for a 2-node canary under staging. owner: marta for infra signoff. ops-bot: please provision.
ops-bot: provisioning request received: staging-canary-oom-test. ETA 2 hours.
aron: Note: adding hard limit may surface GC gaps. We should set eviction policy to 'lru-prioritize' to avoid P99 latency regressions. Testing now.
sasha: FYI snippet of failing log:
```
runtime: goroutine 12345 [running]:
 main.(*kvShard).free+0x1f2
 ...
```
marta: Decision: run two parallel experiments this week: (A) aggressive GC + compact every 30s; (B) shard hard limit + eviction. Keep both for 48h and compare leak trend.
vijay: I'll wire up a simple regression metric: 'shard_resident_bytes' and alert if growth > 5% over 1h. owner: vijay. ETA: 6 hours.
aron: Hard limit rollout plan: bake in staging -> canary -> gradual 25% traffic steps. If latency or errors spike, rollback automatically. Will post rollout plan link.
marta: Will own cross-team comms and postmortem update. Action: update PM notes with owners/timelines by EOD.
sasha: Quick question: for jemalloc profiling I need debug symbols. Are we ok to enable SYMBOLS=true build for canary? builds-team?
deploy-bot: build/ci triggered: build-2009-cache-debug (SYMBOLS=true). Status: queued.
aron: If we see fragmentation ratios >0.6, we should try the compacter patch (sasha's WIP) early.
vijay: added grafana dashboard panel and alert rule draft: https://grafana.company/s/dashboards/kv-oom-fugitive
marta: Good progress. Follow-ups recap:
- sasha: minimal repro + compacter patch (3d)
- aron: shard hard limit + rollout plan (1d)
- vijay: alerts + jemalloc profile (6h)
- marta: canary infra signoff + PM notes (EOD)
We'll have a 15min sync tomorrow 10:30am to review canary metrics. Please add anything missing.
aron: added notes to the rollout doc. :thumbsup:
sasha: will post repro link in thread when ready.
vijay: I'll attach the jemalloc heap diff when available.
marta: Thanks team — keeping this thread as the single source of truth. :white_check_mark:
